item.title: Flipper Zero for testing old dusty electronic components
item.description:
Dimmable LED

On high frequencies (> 50 Hz), blinking of a LED becomes undistinguishable from a bright light. By using pulse width, the “brightness”, or it’s perception can be controlled.
